affiliation_boundary: Fixed PDF first author superscript 1 is Washington University in St. Louis; a footnote attributes work to a Google Cloud AI Research internship. Google collaboration is not reassigned as first-author institutional affiliation.

sources.purpose: Original arXiv timestamp; PDF August 21 header does not override August 20 first submission.
Exact interface operators, real-model design loop, scope restrictions, costs and full-training hardware.
Visually checked PDF first-page byline and internship footnote, not inferred from collaborators.
Official released implementation and external commercial-model/benchmark dependencies.

local_components: StageWrapper ordinary step replay followed by notify_replay_complete
ContractWrapper trusted action/transition/observation hooks with verifier delegation
SerialChain lazy B, shared submitted-step budget and cached original-verifier conjunction
fidelity_notes: Prepared replay must remain nonterminal; no private simulator state injection.
Blocked actions do not call inner.step; they re-observe and filter the current state.
Local hooks may terminate early, not revive a terminated inner task; failed step/reset callbacks require reset.
Serial A failure or shared-budget exhaustion does not start B or manufacture composite success.
No full upstream ABI, source compiler, sandbox, persistence, EnvRigger, actor, skills, RL or benchmark bridge is claimed. No gold is supplied to an actor.

full_experiment.basis: Appendix G estimates 228.0M ALFWorld and 137.3M WebArena total tokens, mainly real-environment rollouts. Appendix F trains Qwen3-8B with GRPO on eight H100s for 150 steps. The full commercial-model, five-benchmark, environment-design/skill/RL matrix exceeds this single-GPU/Mac component budget. No API, training probe, checkpoint or real environment benchmark was run.
